name: bagsy-monorepo
description: Bagsy a concept so your agents don't clobber the brain.

scripts.test: bun run test:cli && bun run test:npm && bun run test:template
scripts.test:template: bun run build:cli && bun run --cwd template test
scripts.demo: bun run build:cli && bun run --cwd template demo
scripts.lint: bun run build:cli && bun run --cwd template lint
